{"gmdn":[{"gmdnCode":"60789","gmdnPTName":"Intracardiac pacemaker","gmdnPTDefinition":"A battery-powered, hermetically-sealed pulse generator impregnated with a steroid (e.g., dexamethasone) intended to be implanted with a catheter, via transvenous access, into the right ventricle (i.e., single-chamber pacing) of an arrhythmic heart to generate/conduct electrical impulses to improve cardiac output.
